text:
maria (PM): quick design check — i'm debating a Compact vs Readable toggle for the evals scorecard density. mock: https://figma.redwood/example :eyes:
joel (Design): i like the toggle name 'Compact / Detailed' — clearer than 'Density' for non-designers
sam (Eng): important: compact mode must keep keyboard focus order identical. we can't reflow controls in a way that breaks tab order
tess (Product): also approval flow — in compact, the primary approve button sits inline with the row. is that ok for discoverability?
joel (Design): inline button keeps scannability, but we should add a persistent sticky action bar on mobile / very small viewports
carla (a11y): a11y nits: ensure the toggle has `aria-pressed` state and label `aria-label=\"Toggle compact view\"`. contrast for status chips drops in compact — needs +2.5 AA at least
maria (PM): good call, carla. can we add a tooltip that appears on hover/focus explaining "Compact hides some context to fit more tests"? copy draft: "Show fewer details for denser lists."
joel (Design): tweak copy to "Show fewer details to view more tests" — more action-oriented. tooltip length should be max 70 chars
sam (Eng): implementation note: compact reduces row height, collapses example input and only shows first result line. that will affect our regression-diff diffing code since we currently map rows by DOM order -> i'll add an id flag to keep diffs stable
tess (Product): question: when a reviewer leaves an inline comment in compact mode, should we open a modal or expand an inline thread? pros/cons?
joel (Design): inline thread keeps context but pushes content down — could break density. modal preserves layout but hides context. leaning inline expandable so comments are visible next to the test
carla (a11y): inline expansion must be reachable via keyboard and announced by screen readers. use `aria-expanded` on the toggle and ensure focus goes into the comment textbox when opened
maria (PM): decision call — go with inline expandable comments + a compact toggle. sam, can you prototype keyboard + focus behavior in the spike?
sam (Eng): yes, i'll prototype and link a small demo. also adding a data attribute `data-test-id=\"eval-row-<id>\"` to make automated tests robust
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging build 2026-04-06T15:00Z will include the compact toggle spike (no backend changes)
maria (PM): thanks all — i'll update the spec doc and include the copy variants. follow-up: can someone mock approval CTA contrast when inline comments are expanded?
joel (Design): i'll post 2 variants by EOD — one with sticky CTA, one inline-only. ping me for quick feedback :thumbsup:
carla (a11y): i'll review both for screen reader flow and contrast before you finalize
tess (Product): perfect — we should plan a short usability test with 3 engineers to watch scan vs deep-review flows
maria (PM): adding that to the sprint. moving to thread close after joel's mocks. thanks!
